title: Cut value
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices, and assign each vertex one of two labels. The cut value of this assignment is the sum of $w(v,u)$ over all ordered pairs $(v,u)$ whose vertices receive different labels.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a weighted directed graph on the vertex set of size $n$
